name: stas
displayName: STAS — Solving Tickets As A Service
description: Submit fix requests to a GitHub bot that investigates, fixes, tests, and opens PRs.
author: Aimino Tech

tools.stas_label_issue: Label a GitHub issue with the STAS fix label
tools.stas_run_fix: Trigger the STAS fix pipeline for a GitHub issue URL
tools.stas_check_status: Check the current status of a STAS fix run
tools.stas_get_pr: Get the PR URL and details for a completed STAS fix run
tools.list_issues: List tracked issues with their STAS fix status
tools.search_codebase: Search the STAS codebase for symbols, files, or patterns

resources.stas://runs/{run_id}: Full run details with status, timestamps, and PR link
resources.stas://issues/{issue_id}: Issue details with fix status and run history
